verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Canva designs carry native comments: they can be received and replied to, added to designs through the MCP server, and synced via the REST APIs. However, it comes from developer and integration docs rather than end-user collaboration docs, and it says nothing about @-mentioning teammates or resolving threads. Missing for 10: evidence of @mentions, thread resolution, first-party end-user docs on in-editor commenting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can comment directly on designs, mention teammates, and resolve threads so review happens in the file, not in email

citations.quote: Receive and reply to Canva comments from any platform and simplify team communication.
Add comments to designs and integrate feedback loops directly into your workflows
You can use the REST APIs to build web apps that create and sync assets, designs, comments, and more.
